purpose: Groups related content and actions on a contained surface.
useWhen: Related content needs a distinct surface and optional header or footer.
A repeated content unit needs consistent internal spacing.

avoidWhen.situation: Content only needs a visual separator.
avoidWhen.guidance: Avoid adding an unnecessary container surface.

avoidWhen.situation: The entire surface must perform an action.
avoidWhen.guidance: Interactive styling does not add button or link semantics; supply an appropriate interactive element.

supportedInteractions: Optional hover and pressed surface feedback.
approvedPatterns: Compose header, title, description, content, and footer parts as needed.
Place header actions in the header action slot.
Place action buttons in the footer.
limitations: Interactive mode only changes visual feedback and cursor behavior.
Header and footer parts are optional.
accessibility: Card Title renders a level-three heading.
Add real button or link semantics for actionable cards.
responsive: Cards fill their container; constrain width in the surrounding layout.
rtl: Header and footer layouts use logical reading order from their content.
